source: Extensive world-model taxonomy supplied in conversation

extractors.name: failure-state
focus: what happens if players do nothing

extractors.name: pressure
focus: economic pressure political pressure demographic pressure military pressure environmental pressure social pressure religious pressure technological pressure resource pressure

extractors.name: power
focus: formal authority informal influence economic power military power religious power magical power informational power social prestige institutional power coercive power

extractors.name: capability
focus: what an actor can actually do

extractors.name: constraint
focus: geographic constraints resource constraints legal constraints political constraints social constraints technological constraints magical constraints financial constraints labor constraints logistical constraints seasonal constraints

extractors.name: bottleneck
focus: capacity bottlenecks transport bottlenecks bureaucratic bottlenecks resource bottlenecks knowledge bottlenecks political bottlenecks

extractors.name: chokepoint
focus: mountain passes bridges ports straits roads city gates canals trade hubs magical portals

extractors.name: substitution
focus: resource substitutes trade-route substitutes labor substitutes technological substitutes magical substitutes political substitutes

extractors.name: competition
focus: actors competing for resources markets territory labor prestige political influence trade routes divine followers magical resources

extractors.name: feedback
focus: positive feedback loops negative feedback loops stabilizing loops destabilizing loops

extractors.name: threshold
focus: points where gradual pressure causes sudden change

extractors.name: cascade
focus: first-order effect second-order effect third-order effect systemic consequences

extractors.name: counterfactual
focus: if X changed, what would probably follow?

extractors.name: opportunity
focus: economic opportunities political opportunities military opportunities criminal opportunities adventure opportunities technological opportunities magical opportunities

extractors.name: provenance
focus: source book page section edition author quote context certainty

extractors.name: epistemic
focus: explicit fact strong implication weak implication inference speculation contradiction unknown

extractors.name: contradiction
focus: fact conflicts date conflicts map conflicts population conflicts identity conflicts edition conflicts source conflicts

extractors.name: change
focus: growth decline centralization fragmentation urbanization migration industrialization militarization commercialization secularization magical expansion environmental degradation

extractors.name: missing
focus: important information that should exist but is absent

extractors.name: plausibility
focus: economic plausibility geographic plausibility demographic plausibility military plausibility technological plausibility ecological plausibility institutional plausibility

extractors.name: identity
focus: same entity? different entities? alias? title? incarnation? historical version?

extractors.name: perspective
focus: author perspective faction perspective regional perspective religious perspective political bias cultural bias unreliable narration

passes.name: structure
passes.purpose: deterministic parsing, source metadata, OCR and section-quality checks

passes.name: relationships
passes.purpose: typed relationships across entity and domain facts

passes.name: systems
passes.purpose: flows, dependencies, capacities, constraints, incentives, power, vulnerability, resilience, coupling, shocks, lags, externalities and adaptation

passes.name: inference
passes.purpose: causal chains, feedback loops, cross-domain consequences, specialist inference, missing infrastructure, opportunities and second-order effects

passes.name: temporal
passes.purpose: states, changes, eras, trends, validity windows

passes.name: epistemic
passes.purpose: provenance, confidence, contradictions, perspectives, edition conflicts

passes.name: world_model
passes.purpose: normalized entities, relations, flows, systems, pressures and states

passes.name: derived_game_world
passes.purpose: adventure hooks and downstream economic, political, trade, demographic and war simulation
